steps.title: K-Culture Media Vocabulary
steps.body: The Korean Wave (한류, Hallyu) has spread Korean pop culture worldwide through music, dramas, films, and beauty. Understanding media vocabulary lets you discuss K-pop, K-dramas, and Korean entertainment in Korean — the native context where these words live.

tip.label: Fan culture vocabulary
tip.text: Korean fan culture has its own rich vocabulary: 팬 (fan), 팬덤 (fandom), 덕후/덕 (passionate fan/otaku), 최애 (favorite/number one), 스밍 (streaming for chart rankings). These words are used daily on social media.

steps.meaning: Drama (K-drama) — 드라마 봐요? (Do you watch dramas?)
steps.meaning_ja: ドラマ（韓ドラ）― 드라마 봐요？（ドラマを見ますか？）

steps.meaning: Music — 한국 음악 좋아해요 (I like Korean music)
steps.meaning_ja: 音楽 ― 한국 음악 좋아해요（韓国の音楽が好きです）

steps.meaning: Idol (K-pop idol) — trained performers in groups like BTS, BLACKPINK
steps.meaning_ja: アイドル ― BTS・BLACKPINKのようなグループ
歌 ― 노래방（カラオケルーム）

steps.meaning: Movie / film — 영화 봤어요? (Did you watch the movie?)
steps.meaning_ja: 映画 ― 영화 봤어요？（映画を見ましたか？）
監督 ― 봉준호 감독（ポン・ジュノ監督）
ファン ― 팬이에요！（ファンです！）

steps.meaning: Concert — 콘서트 가요? (Are you going to the concert?)
steps.meaning_ja: コンサート ― 콘서트 가요？（コンサートに行きますか？）
ステージ / 舞台 ― 무대 위에서（ステージの上で）

steps.meaning: Korean Wave / Hallyu — the global spread of Korean culture
steps.meaning_ja: 韓流 / ハルリュ ― 韓国文化の世界的な広がり
人気 ― 인기 많아요！（とても人気があります！）

steps.meaning: Photo — 사진 찍어도 돼요? (May I take a photo?)
steps.meaning_ja: 写真 ― 사진 찍어도 돼요？（写真を撮ってもいいですか？）

steps.meaning: Fan meeting — a major K-pop fan event where fans meet their idols
steps.meaning_ja: ファンミーティング ― K-POPファンがアイドルに会う大型イベント

steps.meaning: Favorite (idol/song/show) — 최애 곡이 뭐예요? (What's your favorite song?)
steps.meaning_ja: 一番のお気に入り ― 최애 곡이 뭐예요？（推し曲は何ですか？）

steps.prompt: 노래방 literally means 'song room.' What is it?

choices: The Korean Wave (global spread of Korean culture)
steps.correct: The Korean Wave (global spread of Korean culture)

steps.prompt: 최애 (choeae) is a K-fan term meaning...
봉준호 감독 is a famous film...

steps.title: Media & K-Culture Complete!
steps.message: 한류를 즐기세요! Now you can talk about your favorite K-dramas, K-pop groups, and Korean films in Korean! Watching content in Korean is one of the fastest ways to level up your language skills.
